verdict.rationale: Kimi is a consumer chat assistant with user accounts, so exporting chat history and account data is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a data-export, chat-history download, or account-data takeout feature. The help-center topics cover search, memory, agents, PPT, plugins and Claw, and the Code docs cover the CLI, IDE and API, but none of these mention export.
